Set up GitHits for your agents

Run this command:

<> bash
npx githits@latest init

What happens next:

  1. Opens your browser to authorize GitHits
  2. Asks whether to set up GitHits at the user or project level
  3. Detects your supported AI coding tools
  4. Lets you choose which tools to configure
  5. Configures the selected tools

Having trouble? Check our documentation.

Superapp

App builders

Prompt-to-app builder for native iOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI, with App Store publishing.

  • Overview

Overview

Superapp is a prompt-to-app builder for native iOS apps. It generates Swift and SwiftUI code and publishes the result to the App Store.

Features

  • Generates native iOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI from prompts.
  • Publishes apps to the App Store.
